text.text_excerpt: We recently had our company holiday party at Filmore in the Oaks. It truly was the perfect venue for our group. Beautifully decorated for Christmas, tables already set up with centerpieces, and just the right size for our attendees. While I didn't eat much of the food, what I had was delicious, and my husband enjoyed everything. Shout out to the Chef for suggesting the addition of bread pudding to our menu - I may have had a tiny bite, and it was so good! The bar has a decent selection, and great service. I will have to make a return trip for a meal outside of our event!

We have gone to Filmore in the Oaks serval times. The food has been very reasonable and good with good service. Today, the food was still good but I like my eggs soft poached on the Benny and the Crabs(cakes) and they were cooked hard. But I must admit they were perfect hard cooked eggs without the gray ring inside. The crab cakes were tasty with nice chunks of crab meat. Something happened in the kitchen and we waited about an hour for the food but they did apologize and comped our mimosas. The waitress was very nice and did a good job. 2 of us ordered from the Coolinary menu and ended up with what looked like a whole fried chicken. They said the crust was very crispy and nicely seasoned...

This review is for Filmore in the Oaks as a private event space only. I attended a baby shower here and I thought it was the perfect spot for a couple reasons. -tons of windows allow for lots of beautiful natural light and views of City Park - ample free parking -nice size space where its big enough to maneuver around, but not too cramped. -good size bar area The event I attended was in the morning so it had brunchy food and it was all really good. I always have slightly lower expectations when it comes to party food, but everything was served hot and full of flavor. I found the staff to be very helpful and courteous as well.
